policies.name: cost_insert
policies.with_check: (app_can_lead(company_id, lead_id) AND (created_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: lead_read
policies.using: ((app_role(company_id) = 'owner'::text) OR ((app_role(company_id) = 'employee'::text) AND (assigned_to = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))

policies.name: note_insert
policies.with_check: (app_can_lead(company_id, lead_id) AND (author = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: time_insert
policies.with_check: (app_can_lead(company_id, lead_id) AND (member_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))
